evidence: Scenario reconciliation for a planning comparison. Land retains the older climate; aquatic carbon-use efficiency is a new illustrative assumption. No 301 K vegetation or ecosystem run is represented.

assumptions.aquatic_gpp: Wetzel's oligotrophic bracket as recorded secondarily in lake_oxygen/sources.json; its central 0.2 g C/m2/day is the oxygen study's scenario. Rates are prescribed means over the whole lunar cycle: the oxygen model calibrates production to this mean, rather than predicting whether lunar organisms achieve it. Applied to both open seas and lakes here.
assumptions.aquatic_npp_over_gpp: New illustrative 0.4-0.6 fraction, not a measurement or an output of the oxygen study. Its community respiration cannot identify autotrophic respiration.
assumptions.coasts: Existing light-limitation design guesses, with matched coast and open-sea areas. Their productive communities and nutrient supply remain to be established.
assumptions.lake_margins: All lake area is assigned oligotrophic production; a separately allocated productive aquatic margin is absent. Terrestrial wet margins remain in the land component.
assumptions.sky: Report host production separately. Do not add it to the surface total until displaced ground and water production is resolved.
assumptions.dry_mass: For an illustrative conversion only, dry biomass is assumed 45 percent carbon by mass in both worlds.
assumptions.planning_range: 15-25 Gt C/year around 20 is a rounded judgment for discussion, not a model confidence interval or a guaranteed bound on the pending climate.

sunlight.status: The revised configuration has not reached a new 301 K equilibrium. Scaling total incident sunlight into proportional surface PAR is only a sensitivity, holding clouds, temperature, rain and spectral shape fixed.

climate_context.claim: Before the final rain/snow changes, projected equilibrium and gust warming suggested 3.5-4.5 percent more sunlight than 0.897; the final configuration still needs short tuning and long design runs.

A28R_301k_s0897 years 5-14: 301.25 K at scale 0.897, +0.02 W/m2 TOA, +0.015 K/year drift. The later October 30 snow result is a smoke test only; uncommitted implementation work was read for status, not consumed as climate data.
